task: ADR-037 NVIDIA reuse + progressive-delivery skill + overlap gate
Round 9 post-creation audit of 4 new skills (PR 936)
roast+merge backlog: close no-impact PRs, review 6 PRs and 1 issue, unbreak main CI
notes: Merged #955 #944 #953 #954 #957 #946 #952 #956; closed #941 with evidence; closed #943 #949 #950 #951 by roast comments. Root cause of red main: ci.yml gated pip install/pytest on hashFiles(requirements.txt) with no root manifest. New finding: the test job was also path-filtered to source extensions, so docs-only PRs got test=skipped and update-ci-status.py correctly refused to certify -> CI Success red; fixed in #957 by making test unconditional, with agents-docs/CI_STATUS.md updated (that doc already said the skip was path-driven and must not be allowlisted). Ops learnings: GITHUB_TOKEN-triggered PR runs return action_required with no jobs (dispatch ci.yml on the branch instead); a bot keeps force-pushing Merge <sha> commits onto PR branches (re-fetch + --force-with-lease after every push); a commit message containing [skip ci] suppresses Codacy on the PR head, leaving the required check unreported and the PR BLOCKED (amend the message to drop it).

Six audit-layer defects fixed, plus one outage the round caused and fixed. (1) secrets-management was invisible to run-evals.py and the README generator: the `secret` prefix tripped a denylist meant for credential files, so the mandatory monthly eval path skipped a security skill and the README published 53/54. Narrowed to substring-prefix matching only after a pre-existing test showed blanket exemption was wrong. (2) Round-10 records were stranded on a bot branch; the lesson collided with an existing LESSON-043 and was renumbered to 046. (3) Plan leftovers archived with evidence after re-verifying the actionlint claim against CI. (4) update-agents-md.sh exited 1 on every invocation behind || true; fixing only the crash would have overwritten the curated AGENTS.md table with a different taxonomy, so it was replaced by a checker. (5) 16 live references to ADR-038-folded skills found and repointed; LESSON-036 had listed the locations but nothing verified them. (6) Lesson triple-write reconciled 46/46 and now enforced. Outage: merging the plans-only archive PR left quality-gate path-skipped -> ci-status unknown -> CI Success failed, turning main red; this was the Round 12 item deferred in ADR-042, reached one PR early and fixed as PR #967. Recurring: the sync-merge bot force-pushes bot-authored merges that cancel in-flight runs and leave Codacy unreportable, so PR #963 needed an explicit workflow_dispatch validation and an admin merge.
